errors_at_half.title: At the default threshold the three models are level: 2 to 3 hijacks let through and 0 to 1 legitimate calls blocked, out of 1,020 rows

operating_points.title: With false blocks held to 5%, none of the three lets a single hijack through on the 217 report-half hijacks

fooling.title: Seeing the planted text helps: with it hidden Clef lets 10% of informed attacks through, with it visible 1.7%

rewording.title: Rewording the question changes under 1% of decisions for all three: 4 to 5 rows of 1,020

speed_cost.title: Jev 1.14 is both the fastest, 199 ms a decision, and the cheapest, $0.023 per 1,000 decisions

frontier.title: The three are level on accuracy, so the frontier is the cheapest alone: Jev 1.14 at $23 per million decisions; Gemini Decision 1 and Clef cost more for the same accuracy

aa_reweighting.title: Drop AA's knowledge and reasoning exams and its Jev vs Gemini tie becomes a 2.6-point Jev lead, at the edge of a ±2.5-point noise band
